Thanks for doing this Andrew. Two minor comments.
I'd suggest adding a conf/machine file for this also.
Any reasoning behind that? It's not something a user could ". setup ibm-enterprise" and build. Are you thinking something like meta-ibm/conf/machine/include/ibm-enterprise.inc?

1) I think it is cleaner in a machine file to do more includes and less "modify some variable".

2) You're quite likely to have other things you decide later on should be in "ibm-enterprise" systems that it'll be handy to have a single place to change that rather than modifying N machines.
Done

Do you still want pstbmc to be overriding p10bmc now?

Seems like maybe it should be just overriding ibm-enterprise, but I'm not sure on your goal.
I'm still waiting for the AST2700 support to get in as that's really what will cause us to define pstbmc as it's own machine line and not need p10bmc anymore.

This stuff all seems bogus.  There is a PACKAGECONFIG[ibm_system] already that enables all of these except PDI.  I don't know why PDI isn't enabled by default everywhere.  And then libgpiod is duplicated twice already (in the DEPENDS and the PACKAGECONFIG).  Can you go ahead and clean all these up while you're at it?
Done
nit: I really wish this would be `ibm-system`.  That can be another commit later I guess.
Acknowledged
I also don't know why this isn't done in openpower-fru-vpd directly.  Don't these JSON files come from the repository?  That seems like a repository-level config then and not a meta-layer one.

ok, I'll add scrubbing this file to my TODO list (and maybe see if I can get the VPD team to do it). I'm cool with quick changes in this commit but for the most part I wanted to do one "switch to ibm-enterprise" commit without changing much else.

Any idea why Gerrit gets confused about the file content here? For me at least Gerrit had 'image/x-ms-bmp' shown in the diff window with no other contents.

I pulled the change down to my local repo in order to view the diffs for this file.
yeah, that's weird! No idea.
The name of this variable should probably change too, right? POWER_SERVICE_PACKAGES_IBM_ENTERPRISE or something?
Done
Looks good to me. Not sure if that is a legit CI issue or an infrastructure issue.

This is probably my inexperience with bitbake, but this file confuses me.

The other machine .conf files are in the parent dir. Was this meant to be in the include subdir? The other files I looked at in includes subdir end with '.inc'.
Ahh whoops, yep, this should be a .inc
Why is the override for the same machine? I thought normally that was a different machine/target that you are "inheriting"?
Yep, this should be a .inc, not a .conf
